name: io.github.orldev/snail-mcp-blender
description: MCP server for Blender: 149 tools, via an add-on here, through an SSH tunnel, or in Docker

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BLENDER_DATA_DIRECTORY
environmentVariables.description: This server's own files: the add-on zip, downloads without a project, the token of a Blender on this machine. Default: ~/.snail-mcp-blender.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BLENDER_PROJECT_DIRECTORY
environmentVariables.description: Over stdio, the project folder: downloads land in it and relative uploads are read from it. Default: the folder the client starts the server in; a server over HTTP has none.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BLENDER_BRIDGE__HOST
environmentVariables.description: Address of the add-on: the loopback, or the Blender container's name when the server runs beside it in Docker. A Blender on another machine is reached through the tunnel instead.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BLENDER_BRIDGE__PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port the server connects to: the add-on's port, or the local end of the SSH tunnel.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BLENDER_BRIDGE__CONNECT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to wait for the socket to open.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BLENDER_BRIDGE__REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to wait for one add-on reply; renders and imports use their own longer timeout.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BLENDER_BRIDGE__TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Shared secret for the add-on; empty reads the token file.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BLENDER_BRIDGE__TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Where to read the add-on's generated token, e.g. a copy of a remote add-on's. Default: <data>/state/token.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BLENDER_BRIDGE__TUNNEL__HOST
environmentVariables.description: user@host of a Blender on another machine: the server keeps an SSH tunnel to it while it runs. Empty keeps the link on this machine.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BLENDER_BRIDGE__TUNNEL__KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key for the tunnel's SSH login; the SSH agent and ~/.ssh/config decide when empty.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BLENDER_BRIDGE__TUNNEL__REMOTE_PORT
environmentVariables.description: The add-on's port on the other machine.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BLENDER_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MINUTES
environmentVariables.description: Over stdio, minutes without a tool call after which the process exits on its own; 0, the default, disables the watchdog, since a client that ends closes the pipe and the server exits with it. A server over HTTP never exits on its own.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BLENDER_SKILL_IDLE_MINUTES
environmentVariables.description: Minutes a loaded skill may go unused before its tools leave the catalog; 0 keeps skills loaded.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BLENDER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Name this server signs its requests with, so the add-on's journal and leases tell agents apart.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BLENDER_BRIDGE__AGENT
environmentVariables.description: The name the link signs its requests with, when it should differ from SNAIL_MCP_BLENDER_AGENT.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BLENDER_PYTHON
environmentVariables.description: How far blender_python may go: allow, fallback (a script only where no dedicated tool covers its work, in sequences and batches too) or off, which also refuses script operators and python steps.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BLENDER_OCIO_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: OpenColorIO config background render jobs run under; empty keeps Blender's own.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BLENDER_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Stdio when the client starts the server, which is how a client runs this package; Http when it runs on its own beside Blender, as the Docker image does, and clients connect to it with a bearer token.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BLENDER_HTTP__URL
environmentVariables.description: Over HTTP: the address to listen on.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BLENDER_HTTP__TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Over HTTP: the token clients present as a bearer on /mcp and at the pages' sign-in; wins over HTTP__TOKEN_FILE. Over HTTP the server refuses to start without one of the two.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BLENDER_HTTP__TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Over HTTP: a file holding that token, the way a container receives a secret.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BLENDER_HTTP__PUBLIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Over HTTP: the address clients reach the server at behind a reverse proxy, which links to files are built on. Default: HTTP__URL.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BLENDER_HTTP__LINK_MINUTES
environmentVariables.description: Over HTTP: minutes a signed file link stays valid, 1 to 1440.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BLENDER_HTTP__UPLOAD_PART_MB
environmentVariables.description: Over HTTP: megabytes an upload sends per request; lower it when a proxy stops reading a body before a part arrives.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BLENDER_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path of an explicit settings file with the same keys under a Snail section.
